title: DyNA-Mixer: Decoupling Time and Topology for Scalable Dynamic Node Affinity Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.24426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous-time dynamic graphs preserve the ordering, timing, and evolving strength of interactions that static snapshots discard, making dynamic graph mining essential for evolving systems such as recommender systems, trade networks, and transaction platforms. Research in this area has centered on dynamic link prediction, which forecasts only whether a future interaction will occur, whereas many applications also need its intensity. The dynamic node affinity prediction (DNAP) problem generalizes this task to continuous targets and full-candidate ranking, making it more broadly applicable but substantially harder. This raises two coupled difficulties: ranking requires a predictor expressive enough to capture both multi-scale temporal evolution and graph-wide collaborative patterns, yet running such a predictor over every source--destination pair is computationally prohibitive. translated_title: DyNA-Mixer：解耦时间与拓扑以实现可扩展的动态节点亲和度预测
translated_abstract: 连续时间动态图保留了静态快照所丢弃的交互顺序、时间信息以及不断演化的交互强度，因此动态图挖掘对于推荐系统、贸易网络和交易平台等持续演化的系统至关重要。该领域的研究一直以动态链接预测为中心，即仅预测未来交互是否会发生，而许多应用还需要预测其强度。动态节点亲和度预测（DNAP）问题将这一任务泛化为连续目标值和全候选集排序，使其具有更广泛的适用性，但难度也显著增加。这带来了两个相互耦合的难题：排序任务需要一个表达能力足够强的预测器，以同时捕捉多尺度的时间演化模式与全图范围的协同模式；然而对每一个源节点—目标节点对都运行这样的预测器，其计算开销是不可承受的。我们提出了 DyNA-Mixer，它将时间预测与拓扑建模解耦。
tldr: DyNA-Mixer 通过将时间演化建模与拓扑结构建模解耦，在保证计算可扩展性的同时捕捉多尺度时间模式与全图协同模式，实现了可扩展的动态节点亲和度预测。
en_tdlr: DyNA-Mixer enables scalable dynamic node affinity prediction by decoupling temporal forecasting from topology modeling, efficiently capturing both multi-scale temporal evolution and graph-wide collaborative patterns.
